# World Travel Patterns

A Luke × Claude, Codex and Grok travel research site for Australian passport holders: entry, local law, culture and protocol, permit zones, seasons and festivals, and consular help for each place, with every rule linked to its source and dated.

A planning aid, not legal advice. A level marked "not yet checked" has unknown rules, not no rules. Rules come from the government, authority or community that owns them; anything else is labelled a signal. Original material uses the Strange But True Public Source Licence; third-party rights remain separate. This voluntary guide grants no additional reuse or AI-training rights.

## Pages

- [Home](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/): Search any place and see what each place page covers.
- [Places](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/places.html): Every country and territory, and the states, councils, islands, nations and permit zones inside them.
- [Advisories](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/advisories.html): Smartraveller advice levels for every destination, checked daily, and each change.
- [Upcoming](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/upcoming.html): Dated events and open calls from GAJRA Earth Ahead, by month and place.
- [Patterns](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/patterns.html): The seventeen questions every place is checked against.
- [How it works](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/how.html): The checks, how rules reach down from country to council, culture and permit zones.
- [Queue](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/queue.html): What gets checked next.
- [Site map](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/site-map.html): Every page, and every country and territory by region.
- [Your view](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/view.html): Choose what this site shows you, kept in this browser only.

## Place pages

- One page per place at https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/place.html?id=<place id>, for example [Fiji](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/place.html?id=fj) and [Minjerribah](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/place.html?id=au%2Fminjerribah). The sitemap lists 1130 of them.

## Data

- [Place records](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/world-travel-patterns/tree/main/data/vetting): one JSON file per place
- [Patterns](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/world-travel-patterns/tree/main/patterns): the seventeen questions
- [Licence](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/world-travel-patterns/LICENCE.md)
